original.statement: Argo CD's Dex integration now always requests the `federated:id` scope.

decision.reason: [ev-f445c4712c8b] lists a bugfix under the "dex" scope: Argo CD now always requests the `federated:id` scope. That fits a protocol-behavior subject. The name "dex-federated-id-scope" uses only words from the evidence, and behavior-changed is the right type because the same configuration now behaves differently. The evidence names dex only as the commit scope, so whether component=dex is the right owner is a judgement call. That is why confidence is low.
